title: Multihair thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman-NUT-AdS$_4$ spacetimes
summary: In this paper, we develop a multihair thermodynamic description of Lorentzian Kerr-Newman-NUT-AdS$_4$ spacetime in which rotation, electric charge, AdS pressure and polar conical tensions enter a homogeneous Christodoulou-Ruffini-type squared-mass formula. The NUT contribution is described by a rotation-like secondary hair $J_n=mn/K^2$ and a charge-like secondary hair $N=n/\sqrt K$. Both depend on the metric parameters of the physical solution family but are varied independently in the enlarged thermodynamic state space.
